__comment: The property is HorizontalAxisKineticBlock.HORIZONTAL_AXIS, which is BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_AXIS - its serialized name is 'axis', NOT 'horizontal_axis'. Getting that wrong matches no variant at all and every state falls back to the missing model. Create's own rotation_speed_controller blockstate keys on 'axis' for the same reason. Model is authored for axis=z and rotated for x.
